bandReport.notes: Pages map to printed pages 37 (idx 18), 39 (idx 19), 41 (idx 20), 43 (idx 21) - only odd printed pages are present, i.e. the English side. Item 81 opens at the top of idx 18 and item 100 is whole at the foot of idx 21 c2, so neither band edge is cut. No item spills past my pages. Idx 21 is the last content page of Paper I and item 100 is the last item; the footer there still prints '[ P.T.O.' even though the paper ends, which is a booklet quirk, not a missing page. COLUMN CROPS: all eight crops split cleanly on the gutter; no line is sliced and no item number is missing from the top of any c2. One caveat - on idx 21 the gutter was detected at x=879 of a 1684px page (about 37px right of centre), so p21-c1.png is wider than its siblings and also catches the centred page number '43'; no c2 text was pulled into it and nothing was lost, so I read that page from the columns as normal (cross-checked against p21.png). Show-through of the Hindi reverse side is visible as faint ghosting on idx 19, 20 and 21 but never obscures the English text. TRANSCRIPTION CHOICES: (1) Item 84 prints genuine bold column headers ('Aircraft type' / 'Description'), so it is rendered as a GFM pipe table; item 96 is also a pairs list but prints NO column headers, so it is kept as roman-numeral lines with the printed colon rather than inventing header text for a table. (2) Item 84 III prints 'C-17 Globe-master III' hyphenated across a line break; transcribed as the whole word 'C-17 Globemaster III'. (3) Item 97 statement III reads 'Strengthening Multiculturalism for Just Global Development and Security' - I checked the word at both column and full-page zoom and it is printed 'Multiculturalism', so that is what is transcribed; recorded here only so a later reader does not mistake it for an OCR slip of mine. (4) Typographic quotes and apostrophes are normalised to ASCII and the en dashes in the item 99 scores to hyphens; no words changed. (5) The booklet's space-before-colon style ('statements :', 'Statement I :') is preserved as printed. SOFT SUBTOPICS not in catalog.json, flagged for possible extension: 'Rare Earth Elements' (item 81, under Chemistry > Inorganic Chemistry: Metals and Minerals - the listed subtopics there cover extraction, batteries and metallurgy impacts, none of which is what the item asks), 'Cloud Seeding' (item 85, under Chemistry > Atmospheric Chemistry and Environmental Pollution), and 'Lokpal and Lokayuktas' (item 98, under Polity and Governance > Constitutional and Statutory Bodies - Lokpal is a statutory body but not a commission, so 'Special Commissions' would be wrong). No question in this band contains mathematics, so there are no LaTeX zones. No duplicated option text and no defective item found.
